name: MTOB
description: MTOB (Machine Translation from One Book) is a benchmark for learning to translate a low-resource language, Kalamang, from a single human-readable grammar book. It evaluates LLMs' ability to learn translation from limited linguistic reference materials rather than large corpora, simulating second language learning.
reputation: A very new niche benchmark for low-resource translation from a single grammar book, with limited community adoption so far.
notes: Focuses on translation for a language with less than 200 speakers; uses field linguistics reference materials; baseline LLMs perform below human level.
